manager.title: Shiqu · Douyin workspace
manager.description: Sign in and operate the Douyin account shared with your Bot
manager.heading: Shiqu · Douyin workspace
manager.intro: Sign in, browse, and interact using your Bot’s Douyin account.
manager.browserHint: Take control to click, type, or drag directly on the screen. The Bot waits until you release control.
manager.emptyHint: Open the browser to view its QR code or sign-in screen. An existing session is reused.
manager.textHint: Click a field in the screen, then send text
manager.textPlaceholder: Phone number, verification code, or message
manager.manualHint: Clicks, comments, and messages use the current account immediately. Complete verification yourself; typed text is not logged by the plugin.
manager.accountHint: After signing in, verify the account and bind it to the Bot. This page and the Bot share one session.
manager.bindAccount: Use this account for the Bot
manager.leaseHint: After you leave, manual control expires within 5 minutes unless renewed.
manager.quickHint: Run structured plugin actions with results you can verify.
manager.resultHint: Input dispatched means the browser received your input. Confirm the final result on screen or in a platform receipt.
manager.settingsHint: These permissions control automated Bot tools. Only Dashboard administrators can save them.
manager.allowedTargets: Allowed user or conversation references (one per line)
manager.allowedOrigins: Allowed AstrBot conversation UMOs (one per line)
manager.chatPermissionsHint: Use /dy status in chat to find your UMO and caller ID. Manual Dashboard actions use your signed-in identity.
manager.receiptsHint: For an unknown result, check receipts and the screen before sending again.
manager.frameRecovered: The browser screen is available again. You can continue operating it.
manager.error_ACCOUNT_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE: The account cannot be verified right now. You can still log in and operate the browser. Refresh status later to verify the account.
manager.error_PLAYWRIGHT_NOT_INSTALLED: Playwright is missing from the AstrBot environment. Install the plugin dependencies, then open the browser again. Automatic retries are paused.
manager.error_BROWSER_NOT_INSTALLED: The browser is missing from the AstrBot environment. Run python -m playwright install chromium there, or install the configured browser, then select Log in / Open browser. Automatic retries are paused.
manager.error_BROWSER_DEPENDENCIES_MISSING: Browser system dependencies are missing. Run python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium in the Linux environment or container running AstrBot, then reopen the browser. Automatic retries are paused.
manager.error_BROWSER_PROFILE_UNWRITABLE: The browser data directory is not writable. Check permissions on the AstrBot data directory, then reopen the browser. Automatic retries are paused.
manager.error_PROFILE_IN_USE: Another instance is using this browser profile. Close that instance, then reopen the browser. Automatic retries are paused.
manager.error_BROWSER_LAUNCH_FAILED: The browser could not start. Check the AstrBot environment and browser configuration, then open it again. Automatic retries are paused.
manager.error_BROWSER_NAVIGATION_FAILED: The Douyin page could not be opened. Check network access from the AstrBot environment. The current browser frame is still requested; use Home or Reload to retry manually.
manager.released: Browser returned. The Bot can use it again.
manager.loginReady: Sign-in screen opened. Scan its QR code or enter the verification code on screen.
manager.accountSaved: The verified current account is now the Bot’s account.
manager.connected: Connected. Open the Bot browser or inspect its current status.
manager.pageInactive: The page is not visible; input is paused.
manager.requestTimeout: The request timed out. Check the screen or receipt before submitting again.
manager.invalidResponse: The host returned an unexpected response. Refresh the page.
manager.operationFailed: The operation did not complete. Refresh the status to check.
manager.refreshBeforeInput: Take control and refresh the screen before entering input.
manager.bridgeMissing: Open this Page from the plugin details in AstrBot.
manager.field_mentions: Mentioned users as a JSON array (optional)
manager.error_CONTROL_REQUIRED: Take control of the Bot browser first.
manager.error_REMOTE_FRAME_STALE: This frame has expired. Refresh it before trying again.
manager.error_REMOTE_SITE_REJECTED: The browser left the allowed Douyin sites. Select Home to recover.
manager.error_PAGE_NOT_READY: Douyin is still on its waiting page. Check the browser screen.
manager.error_LOGIN_REQUIRED: Sign in to Douyin and refresh the account status.
manager.error_ACTION_NOT_GRANTED: This Bot action is not granted. Update Bot permissions first.
manager.error_ACCOUNT_NOT_BOUND: Bind the verified current account to the Bot first.
manager.error_PLUGIN_DISABLED: Enable and save the plugin in Bot permissions first.
manager.error_ACCOUNT_PAUSED: Bot operations are paused. Resume them first.
manager.error_TARGET_NOT_GRANTED: The recipient or mentioned user is not in the allowed targets.
manager.error_CONFIG_READ_ONLY: The host cannot save plugin settings. Update AstrBot.
manager.error_SERVICE_CLOSED: The plugin has stopped. Reload it and reopen this page.
manager.error_RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND: No receipt was found for this action. Check the screen first.
manager.releaseBeforeQuick: Return browser control before running a quick action.
manager.inputDispatched: Input dispatched. Check the result on screen.
